Shape Security Outcomes Across Complex Systems from Concept Through to Deployment   Your new company     
 Our client is a leading organisation operating within a highly secure and technologically advanced environment and is seeking to engage a Cyber Security Systems Engineer on a permanent basis. This is a Brisbane-based opportunity supporting the development of complex, next-generation technology platforms where cyber security is embedded from concept through to deployment. Working within a multidisciplinary engineering environment, you will help shape security outcomes across systems, software, infrastructure and supporting technologies. 
   
 Please note this role requires onsite attendance in Brisbane a minimum of 4 days per week and cannot be performed remotely. Brisbane-based candidates are preferred, however interstate candidates who are genuinely committed to relocating are encouraged to apply. An NV1 Security Clearance is required for this role. 
   Your new role     As a Cyber Security Systems Engineer, you will work at the intersection of cyber security, systems engineering and security assurance, ensuring security is embedded throughout the design and development lifecycle of complex technology solutions. You will partner closely with software, systems and engineering teams to identify risks early, influence architectural decisions and implement Security by Design principles from requirements definition through to system delivery.     Key responsibilities include:     
 
 Driving Security by Design and secure engineering practices across system lifecycles    
 Conducting threat modelling, security risk assessments and security assurance activities    
 Developing and managing security requirements and controls    
 Supporting the design and implementation of secure system architectures    
 Working within Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) environments    
 Translating security frameworks, standards and governance requirements into engineering outcomes    
 Supporting verification, validation and security accreditation activities    
 Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams to mitigate security risks    
 Maintaining security artefacts, technical documentation and design records    
 Contributing to the ongoing maturity of cyber security engineering practices    
 
  What you'll need to succeed     You will bring a blend of cyber security, systems engineering and security assurance experience, with the ability to operate in complex and highly regulated technical environments.     Essential:     
 
 Cyber Security Engineering, Systems Security Engineering or Security Architecture    
 Threat modelling and security risk assessment methodologies    
 Security Assurance and Security by Design principles    
 Requirements development, traceability and security controls implementation    
 Systems Engineering or Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE)    
 Translating governance, risk and compliance requirements into practical engineering solutions    
 Working within secure development or complex engineering environments    
 Stakeholder engagement across technical and non-technical teams    
 An NV1 security clearance   
 
  Highly desirable:     
 
 Cameo Systems Modeler, MagicDraw, Sparx Enterprise Architect or IBM DOORS    
 Secure software development lifecycles    
 Defence, aerospace, government or critical infrastructure environments    
 CISSP, CISM, CRISC or similar    
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 The ability to influence security outcomes from design through to deployment    
 Exposure to cyber security engineering, systems assurance and emerging technologies    
 A collaborative environment working alongside highly skilled engineering professionals    
 Long-term career growth and professional development opportunities    
 
  What you need to do now     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.    Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
IT Systems Analyst
Full-time
Glow Health Care Australia Pty Ltd trading as Glow Health Care Australia
Parramatta, NSW
Salary: $80,000–$100,000 plus superannuation
About the Role
Glow Health Care Australia is seeking an experienced IT Systems Analyst to support and improve the technology systems used across our disability, aged care, home care, allied health and NDIS service operations.
In this role, you will work with managers, employees, external vendors and technology teams to identify business needs, analyse existing systems and implement practical technology solutions. You will help ensure our systems are secure, reliable, compliant and aligned with the organisation’s operational requirements.
Duties and Responsibilities
•	Analyse existing systems, applications and business processes to identify opportunities for improvement. 
•	Consult with stakeholders to gather and document functional and technical requirements. 
•	Translate business requirements into system designs and technical specifications. 
•	Prepare system workflows, process maps, data mappings and functional documentation. 
•	Recommend system enhancements, new applications and improvements to existing platforms. 
•	Coordinate the implementation and rollout of new systems and system upgrades. 
•	Develop and conduct system, integration and user acceptance testing. 
•	Investigate system defects and coordinate resolutions with vendors and development teams. 
•	Support the integration of third-party applications with internal systems and platforms. 
•	Monitor system interfaces and data flows to maintain accuracy and interoperability. 
•	Prepare user guides, technical procedures, training materials and system documentation. 
•	Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for complex system-related issues. 
•	Assist with staff training and change-management activities during system implementations. 
•	Ensure systems comply with privacy, cybersecurity, data-governance and healthcare requirements. 
•	Conduct post-implementation reviews and recommend further system improvements. 
Skills and Qualifications
•	Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Information Systems or a related discipline. 
•	At least two to three years of relevant experience as a Systems Analyst, Business Systems Analyst or in a similar ICT position. 
•	Experience analysing, implementing and supporting organisational or enterprise systems. 
•	Strong knowledge of requirements gathering, process mapping and technical documentation. 
•	Experience with system integration, APIs, databases and data modelling. 
•	Experience conducting integration testing and user acceptance testing. 
•	Familiarity with SQL, Visio, Jira, Confluence or similar tools. 
•	Understanding of Agile, Waterfall or other software-development methodologies. 
•	Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
•	Ability to communicate technical information clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
•	Knowledge of information security, privacy and data-governance principles. 
•	Experience in healthcare, disability, aged care, community services or NDIS operations is desirable. 
•	ITIL, CBAP, PRINCE2 or similar certification would be advantageous. 
How to Apply
Please submit your résumé and a cover letter outlining your relevant qualifications and experience.
Glow Health Care Australia is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates from all backgrounds.

result.description:
The Client: 

ZED Real Estate is an industry-disrupting, high-performance luxury property group and is known as one of the most digitally progressive real estate advisory firms in Australia. Due to their expanding international footprint of advisors and corporate offices spanning Melbourne, Queensland, and Dubai, their infrastructure requires enterprise-grade engineering and now seek an experienced Computer?Network and System Engineer to join the team in Hampton East, Victoria. 

?? 

The Role: 

This is a full time role with an annual salary set at $150,000 plus superannuation, and will be based in Hampton East, Victoria. 

? 

The Responsibilities: 

Design, deploy, and manage secure, high-availability Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless environments across all corporate offices, including Hampton East (VIC), Mermaid Beach (QLD), and Dubai. 

Implement advanced networking technologies and configure routers, firewalls, and network switches to prioritise high-bandwidth traffic, ensuring seamless VoIP communication.  

Create, update, and maintain detailed technical documentation, including network inventories, configuration change logs, maintenance procedures, and fault resolution records. 

Design and deploy network configurations, incorporating high-availability routing protocols, Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs), Quality of Service (QoS) rules, and secure site-to-site VPN tunnels. 

Implement SoftwareDefined Networking (SDN) and develop programmatic, APIdriven workflows across network hardware using automation tools such as PowerShell, Bash, Python, and RESTful integrations to improve operational efficiency and system reliability. 

Monitor and analyse network traffic, capacity, and utilisation metrics, and evaluate endtoend network infrastructure performance across all corporate office locations. 

Evaluate and propose technical enhancements to network operations, interconnected server infrastructure, internal hardware, distributed PropTech applications, and hybrid operational environments. 

Optimise 4K media-rendering architectures and secure localised Network attached Storage (NAS) configurations, improving internal high-volume data-pipeline workflows for the marketing division. 

Oversee network and system configurations to ensure smooth data flows between real estate-specific APIs, external listing syndications (e.g., Realestate.com.au, Domain), and internal master CRMs. 

Provision, test, and deploy complex server networks, cloud systems (Microsoft 365, Azure Active Directory / Entra ID), and endpoint systems using modern Mobile Device Management (MDM) software. 

Formulate comprehensive testing strategies to validate network throughput, failover systems, and server redundancy, ensuring the agency maintains its strict zero-downtime metric during business hours. 

Provide expert troubleshooting and fault-finding services to isolate, diagnose, and resolve intricate network bugs, hardware failures, system anomalies, or cross-platform software conflicts. 

Troubleshoot complex issues across hardware, networks, software, database applications, servers, and workstations, coordinating with internal teams and vendors, and maintaining high service standards. 

Actively contribute to ZED Real Estate’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) by supporting the implementation and upkeep of its policies, procedures and controls, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information in alignment with ISO/IEC?27001. 

Design and execute network security baselines, including Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), Zero-Trust conditional access rules, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and advanced endpoint detection systems. 

Architect and manage Identity and Access Management (IAM) lifecycle workflows to enforce continuous security baselines across automated user onboarding and offboarding frameworks. 

Create, test, and preserve robust data backup structures, comprehensive disaster recovery workflows, and Business Continuity Plans (BCP) to secure sensitive real estate escrow accounts and high-net-worth data. 

 

The Requirements: 

A Bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in Network Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related ICT Major. 

At least 5 years of relevant professional experience as a Network Engineer, Systems Engineer, or ICT Systems Administrator in a corporate setting 

Professional infrastructure certifications are highly regarded (e.g., Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, CompTIA Security+). 

At least 5 years demonstrated experience of core networking models and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, VPN, switching, routing). 

At least 5 years experience managing corporate directory platforms and infrastructure identities (Microsoft cloud technologies, including Microsoft 365, Entra and Intune). 

Must have over 5 years’ experience to implement, administer, and troubleshoot network infrastructure devices, including wireless access points, firewall, routers, switches, controllers 

Must know how to setup virtual configurations in VMWare vSphere and Hyper-V 

At least 5 years of experience with server virtualisation, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and hybrid integration projects. 

Strong analytical skills and sound administration skills 

Quick to grasp new ideas and concepts 

Ability to work to tight deadlines and under immense pressure at times

result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Your role at St John of God Health Care 

As a Senior Cyber and Operational Technology Security Engineer you will be at the heart of our security operations helping to safeguard the organisation from cyber threats. You will be responsible for the design, implementation and maintenance of the digital security systems and processes that protect our caregivers, patients, and information.

Additionally, you will be responsible for overseeing cyber security engineering of St John of God Health Care's Operational Technology (OT) - including facilities, clinical - medical operational technologies, and associated Internet of Things (IoT) devices - to protect, detect and respond to cyber threats across the organisation.

The Position

Building, operating, and continuously improving cybersecurity tools and processes

Act as the senior SME for integrated OT, cloud, and data security, providing authoritative technical guidance on secure architecture, design patterns, and control implementation.

Support the design and maintenance of OT security reference architectures aligned to Australian regulatory requirements and industry standards (including AS-IEC 62443 and Purdue principles), incorporating segmentation, DMZs, and least-privilege remote access.

Establish and maintain OT asset discovery and inventory using passive, protocol-aware techniques, and configure and tune monitoring and anomaly-detection capabilities in safety-critical environments.

Provide senior technical input to IT-OT network segmentation initiatives in collaboration with network, facilities, and engineering teams.

Provide technical oversight and integration guidance for enterprise security platforms (including SIEM, XDR-EDR, CASB, vulnerability management, and firewalls), including OT telemetry integration, in collaboration with SOC-MSSP providers.

Establish and maintain visibility, security baselines, and monitoring for IoT and connected devices supporting facilities and clinical operations, ensuring OT-safe methods that protect service continuity and safety.

Define and maintain OT-appropriate vulnerability, patching, cyber risk controls, and change management approaches that balance cyber risk reduction with clinical safety and service availability.

Define, implement and assure OT vendor and supply-chain security controls, including secure remote access patterns (jump hosts, MFA, time-bound access, monitoring), contractual security requirements, and validation of third-party controls for clinical and facilities technologies.

Lead OT cyber risk assessments and security uplift planning aligned to AS-IEC 62443 concepts (e.g., zone-conduit design and target security levels), ensuring risk treatments are practical for safety-critical operations and clinical environments.

Provide senior technical input into cyber incident preparedness and response across IT and OT environments, including developing OT-safe runbooks, supporting incident detection and remediation, and contributing to exercises and readiness assessments..

Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to investigate, resolve, and document incidents, ensuring root-cause analysis and lessons learned inform future improvements.

You will have demonstrated technical understanding and expertise in OT security and architecture, with demonstrated experience integrating OT controls with enterprise cyber security capabilities (e.g., SIEM-XDR, identity controls, and data protection-DLP) where OT systems interface with IT or cloud platforms. Additionally you will have strong demonstrable experience supporting cyber incident response and management activities across IT and OT environments.

To succeed you will have:

At least three years' experience in equivalent roles

Tertiary qualified in Information Systems, Cyber Security or a related discipline, and - or hold relevant industry Security Certifications (CSEC ,CEH, OSCP, vendor certifications, etc.)

Experience in health care, or a critical infrastructure industry will be looked upon favourably.

Above all, people will be at the core of everything you do committing to and supporting our Mission and Values.

We can offer you

Salary: $160,267 to $173,035 base per annum, plus 12% superannuation

Permanent full-time position working 76 hours per fortnight

Located at Perth CBD (Kings Square) or Melbourne CBD (Collins St) offices

Hybrid working arrangements

Salary packaging up to $18,550 on a range of benefits such as mortgage, rent, meal entertainment, holiday accommodation or other everyday living expenses as well as options to salary package benefits above the FBT cap on items such as:

Novated leasing 

work related expenses

self-education and

additional superannuation

Employee discount on St John of God Hospital & Medical Services and Private Health Insurance

Employee support through our dedicated free Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

A healthy work-life balance through flexible work options, additional purchased leave and well-being programs

Access to a range of Lifestyle, Health & Wellbeing rewards and discounts

End of trip bike and shower facilities (Perth only)

Close to Public Transport

If suitable applicants are identified advertisement may close prior to listed date and screening-interviews may commence throughout the advertising process.

Please note unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies will not be accepted. 

St John of God Health Care embraces diversity and strongly encourages applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and people with disabilities. We are committed to providing a safe environment for all children and vulnerable people in our care and proactively take measures to protect children-vulnerable people from abuse. result.description:
Assertiv is an IT Security company specialising in Identity related solutions, support, training and managed services. We are currently looking for a talented IDAM Security Engineer with a background in designing, developing, implementing and supporting Identity Security solutions.

We are seeking candidates who possess good technical knowledge and experience with Opentext NetIQ Identity Governance, Silverfort Identity Security Platform, Microsoft Entra ID and related technologies and are willing to do the hard yards when it comes to delivering successful outcomes for our customers. In return, we will provide you with training across a variety of products, on-site (or remote) customer experience, and the support of a great team to help you further develop your skills and experience in IT Security.

Role Description

This role will engage in workforce and customer Identity related projects and undertake the following project-based activities:

· Install and configure Workforce and Customer Identity products.

· Install and configure Identity Security products including ISPM and ITDR.

· Develop integrations between Identity systems and business applications, specifically onboarding applications to Identity Governance systems.

· Conduct functional testing and undertake code fixes as required.

· Assist with System, Integration, Performance and User Acceptance Testing.

· Assist with documentation (Solution Design, Test Cases, Deployment Guides, As-built documents).

· Develop drivers and connectors for connected applications.

· Design and implement single sign-on using open standards (OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, WS-FED).

· Design and implement advanced authentication processes (Multi-Factor, Risk Based Auth).

· Assist with handover and/or training to customer BAU/Operations teams.

· Provide ongoing solution support for customer implementations.


We are looking for candidates with the following attributes and experience:

· University graduated, with coursework around software development, computer networks, and web development.

· Two or more years of professional work experience with Workforce and/or Customer Identity related products such as NetIQ, Silverfort, Ping Identity, and Microsoft Entra.

· Experience with developing, implementing, and configuring complex IT Security solutions.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

· Security concepts and principles (e.g. knowledge of SAML and OAuth).

· Strong programming and scripting skills (Java, PowerShell, JavaScript, Bash, etc.).

· Networking technologies and concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, firewalls).

· Virtualisation, Citrix, VMware.

· Cloud computing – AWS, Azure, Google, and hybrid environments.

· Windows Server/Active Directory/ADFS

· Linux (Red hat and/or SUSE), IOS, Android.


We are a focused team with highly experienced staff, a great offering, and you will be part of a growing team with a fun and positive culture. Whatever your goals, there will be plenty of room for career advancement as we grow. Remuneration will be commensurate with skills and experience. If this is the opportunity you have been waiting for, then we want to hear from you! Your resume will be assessed by our team, and if we feel that you could be a good fit, we will be in touch regarding the next steps.
